From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: MAP Kickoff & Evaluation Plan — Helix Health / Redwood

Hi Jana, Arjun, Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have clear roles, success criteria, and an escalation path while you run the Q3 evaluation with Redwood. I’ve attached a draft evaluation plan (MAP_Q3_eval_plan_v1.pdf) and a quick security Q&A.

High-level goals for the MAP:
- Executive alignment: confirm Helix exec sponsor and primary outcomes for the quarter (latency targets, integration scope, and cost/unit expectations).
- Technical evaluation: sandbox access, test dataset, and performance baselines for inference latency and cost.
- Procurement & legal: timeline for PO/contract signature to meet targeted production date.

Proposed roles from Redwood:
- Executive sponsor / account lead: Kimberly Park (me) — exec liaison and commercial approvals.
- Solutions lead: Rishi Malhotra — integration, test harness, and benchmark support.
- Customer success / onboarding: Marissa Cole — rollout plan and success metrics.

Request from Helix:
- Please confirm your executive sponsor for the MAP (VP/CTO level preferred), the internal technical owner for the POC, and a procurement contact.
- Can we schedule a 30-minute executive alignment call next week to confirm quarterly outcomes and the escalation path? I’m proposing: Tue 2027-04-27 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 2027-04-28 09:00–09:30 PT.

Attachments: MAP_Q3_eval_plan_v1.pdf (draft), security_q_a.xlsx (initial answers).

If you’re happy with the draft MAP, we’ll convert it into a living checklist and track progress in the shared Drive link below.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Kimberly — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. I’ll be Helix’s executive sponsor for this MAP. High-level priorities from my side:
- Validate latency SLOs for our peak inference windows (95th percentile targets).
- Confirm data controls and retention behavior (SOC2 + custom retention window).
- Make sure the evaluation can demonstrate TCO improvements versus our current setup.

I’ve copied Tom (our PM) and Jana (Dir., Data Platform) — they’ll drive day-to-day execution. Tom, Jana: can you confirm the technical owner and procurement contact?

I can do the executive alignment call on Tue 2027-04-27 at 10:00 PT. Quick note on escalation: if we hit an architectural blocker during the POC, please escalate to Marcus Lin (our head of infra). Kimberly, please confirm Redwood’s escalation contact (VP-level or engineering lead).

Best,
Arjun
CTO, Helix Health
arjun.patel@helixhealth.com

Thanks, Arjun. Great to meet you virtually — excited to partner on the evaluation. A couple of technical clarifications and a tentative test plan:

1) Sandbox & data: we’ll provision a scoped sandbox environment with sample payloads by EOD Thu 2027-04-29. We will not persist PII in the sandbox; the initial test set will be synthetic copies of your telemetry.

2) Benchmarks: Rishi’s proposed 3-step benchmark: baseline run (3 days), heavy load run (95th percentile measurement), and stress test (burst traffic). We’ll provide scripts and a README in the Drive folder. Expected deliverables: latency report, token-cost breakdown, and a short recommendation doc on quantization/instance sizing.

3) Escalation flow: first contact — Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com) for day-to-day issues; if unresolved in 24 hours escalate to Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> (product infra). Marcus is copied on this thread (internal contact).

Open items for Helix: procurement lead and a list of the test dataset owners.

—Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
